planner.bar_note: The optimiser makes a move only when it gains more than 0.5 expected points over the rest of the plan (4.5 if it costs a -4 hit), so it doesn't churn on small differences.

wildcard.why: After the round of 16, half the clubs are out. MD11 already has unlimited transfers, so the Wildcard is most useful at a quarter-final or semi-final first leg (MD13 or MD15), if more of your players are out than your 5 free transfers can replace.

limitless.why: Only two clubs play the final and the club limit rises to 8, so a one-day team with no budget limit can be filled with the best players of both finalists.

chips.summary: Keep both chips for the knockouts: the best use before the play-offs (wildcard on MD7) is worth only 4.6 points, against what they can do at the quarter-finals and the final.

between_days.note: Between-days advice appears after the first match day.

notes.average: The game average is an estimate from ownership: UEFA shows the real one only after you log in.
notes.my_team: Reading your own UCL team needs a UEFA login, so XPert recommends the squad to create and gives between-days advice for that squad.
notes.hindsight: Best possible uses the real results, which nobody knows in advance; it shows the ceiling, not a fair target.
notes.prices: Prices change from MD3; the plan uses today's prices.
